concerns.text: The GHTorrent entry lists “*No verified URL* (see constitution)”. Constitution Principle II requires every external citation to be verified; the lack of a reachable, verified URL makes this dataset citation non‑compliant.

CodeSearchNet (Java subset) is offered as a secondary fallback, but it does not provide commit history or issue linkage needed to generate the binary bug‑fix labels required by FR‑003. Using it would prevent the pipeline from satisfying the bug‑label reliability requirement.
